title: Ulyana and the Echo
author: Emrys Villalobos
blurb: Ansel Montrose, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
